description: Explicitly scan local AI CLI artifacts and update the local TokenTrace database. Requires confirmLocalScan=true.

confirmLocalScan.description: Must be true to confirm local file reads and local database writes.

folders.description: Optional local folders to scan. Defaults to TokenTrace's supported local roots.

force.description: Force parser reprocessing for files that would otherwise be deduplicated.

name: run_scan
title: Run local scan
